content: Pauro ararwaaza kubhano bhatari Abhayahudi
Kweego, enye Pauro wuno nibhohirwe kwe ekigirirye kyo okukora emirimo gya Krisito Yeesu, kweemwe bhano mutari Abhayahudi, nirabhasabhira.
Kwe eheene mumariri kwiigwa iguru we emirimo gino Taatabhugya aniheeri orubhaango rwaaye nibharaarikire emwe.
Taatabhugya omweene akaanikuundukurira embiso yaaye, kyeego niari nibhakaamiiri iguru wa amangʼana masuuhu.
Kwo okusoma gayo, muranagya okumenya kyeego nimenyiri embiso ya Taatabhugya iguru wa Krisito.
Ekare hayo, Taatabhugya yaari ataabhakuundukuriiri abhaatu bhe eziinyiibhuro zyoosi, kyeego abhakuundukuriiri abheega na abharooti bhaaye abhahoreeru kwe enzira ye Ekoro Muhoreeru.

Embiso eyeene ni yino, kwe enzira yo okugiikirirya Amangʼana Amazomu, abhaatu bhano bhatari Abhayahudi nibho abhagabhi hamwe na Abhayahudi, ebhiimo bhyo omubhiri gumwe na bhiisaangye hamwe no obhurage bhwaaye kwe enzira ya Krisito Yeesu.
Taatabhugya akaanikora kubha omuhokya wo okuraarika Amangʼana Amazomu, okutuukana ne esaambo yo orubhaango rwaaye. Akaaniha esaambo yiyo kwo obhunagya bhwaaye obhukuru.

Yiingabha enye ni musuuhu kukira kubhahoreeru bhoosi, nawe Taatabhugya akaaniha orubhaango runo, nibharwaazire abhaatu bhano bhatari Abhayahudi obhuniibhi bhwaaru bhwo orubhaango rwa Amangʼana Amazomu gano gakubhoneka ku Krisito.
Kweeki, akaaniha emirimo gyo okubhabhuurira abhaatu bhoosi, bhamenye amangʼana ge embiso yaaye yino yaari ebhisirwe kweema obhweemero, na Taatabhugya, Omubhuumbi we ebhigiro bhyoosi.
Bhoono, kwe enzira ye ekanisa, amangʼeeni goosi ga Taatabhugya gabhone kumenyekana kubhakaangati bha mukyaaro kino kitakurorekana.
Gayo goosi, Taatabhugya akakora ego kwe ekigirirye kya amiiseego gaaye ga kirakeego, kwo okuhitira Krisito Yeesu Omukuru weetu.
Kwo okuhitira ku Krisito, kwo okubha turamwiikirirya no okugwaatana neewe, tuno obhunagya bhwo okumwiisukiirira Taatabhugya kwo obhukaari, na tutana bhwoobha.
Kweego, nirabhasabha mutakwa emitima kwe ekigirirye kye enyaako yaane kwiiguru weenyu, gayo ni kwo obhuguungo bhweenyu.
Amasabhi ga Pauro kubhiikirirya bha Efeso
Gayo nigo gakugirya niramwiihigamira no okumusabha Taata.
Ewe niwe Omuteemi we esimuka ye ebhigiro bhyoosi bhya mwiisaaro na mukyaaro.
Niramusabha Taatabhugya wo obhuguungo bhwaaru, abhahe eziinguru muziikoro zyeenyu kwe enzira ye Ekoro yaaye mugumire,
okubha Krisito yiikare muziikoro zyeenyu kwo obhwiikirirya. Niramusabha mubhone kubha eriitina no obhurusa bhwo obhuseegi.
Nirasabheego kubha, mubhone okumenya hamwe na abhahoreeru bhoosi, kyeego bhuri obhuseegi bhwa Krisito kwo obhugari no obhutaambi, no okugya iguru na koongoriko.
Nirasabha mumenye kubha, obhuseegi bhwa Krisito kyeego bhwaaruhiri, bhuno bhukuhita obhumenyeekererya bhwa abhaatu. Nirasabheego okubha eteemo yeenyu etuubhane na Taatabhugya omweene.

Ambe, tumuguungye Taatabhugya, ewe aranagya okukora amangʼana ge ekiruguuro bhukongʼu, kukira goosi gano tukusabha kasi tukwiiseega. Ewe arakora kuriingʼaana no obhunagya bhuno bhukukora emirimo muusi weetu.
Kweego, Taatabhugya aguungibhwe mumakanisa na mu Krisito Yeesu, kuziinyiibhuro zyoosi, kirakeego na kirakeego. Gabhe ego.
